definitions.explanation: The introductory section of a book, story, or other work. Also used figuratively to describe the beginning phase of a larger event or development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序章|じょしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Read the prologue of the novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序章|じょしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎなかった→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: This incident was merely the prologue to a tragedy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、より⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{変革|へんかく}→変革：12100_henkaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序章|じょしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Experts point out that this reform is merely the prologue to an even greater transformation.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both literally for the opening section of a written work and figuratively for the beginning of a larger chain of events. The figurative usage often carries ominous or dramatic overtones.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{序章|じょしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to be merely the prologue to ~
- {序章|じょしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる: to serve as a prologue

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧ is the author's preface or foreword, while {序章|じょしょう} is the opening chapter of the narrative itself.
